alt: 진입 대기 큐와 x·y 조건 대기 큐가 분리된 모니터
prompt: Create ONE original raster PNG technical educational diagram for a Korean IT blog. White opaque background, navy readable sans-serif text, flat blue/teal boxes, generous whitespace. Use only the exact subject and components below. No logos, watermark, decorative illustrations, unrelated graphs, extra numeric values or invented facts. Redesign composition rather than copy source. Every connection must be accurate and labels fully readable.  Title Monitor with condition variables. Monitor boundary includes Shared data, Operations, Initialization code. Entry queue outside above: three waiting cards. Separate x condition queue THREE waiting cards and y condition queue TWO waiting cards drawn alongside boundary. Highlight ONE active thread in operations. Annotate x.wait(): release monitor and wait in x queue. Annotate x.signal(): notify a waiter in x queue. Do not draw direct handoff to running; footer A notified waiter follows the monitor scheduling rules. No promise signal grants the lock immediately. Distinguish entry queue from x/y queues.
